attack_plan.narrative: Recent reports indicate that President Putin has not been seen in public since his last televised address on March 13. This uncharacteristic absence has raised eyebrows among political analysts and military observers alike. Sources close to the Kremlin have stated that President Putin was observed in the Stockholm Archipelago, a secluded area known for its natural beauty and privacy, around mid-July. The exact duration of his stay remains unclear. An anonymous source claims to have witnessed unusual activity at the Kremlin, suggesting that there may be ongoing power dynamics within the Russian leadership. These rumors include speculation about a potential 'palace coup' against President Putin. While some speculate that Putin’s absence might signal a palace coup, other experts argue that it could simply be due to health concerns or diplomatic engagements. However, the sudden and unexplained nature of his absence continues to fuel conspiracy theories. The State Department is also concerned about a possible coup against Vladimir Putin and will continue to monitor the situation closely.
